newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler buys back $452 mln of stock in Q3.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler buys back $452 mln of stock in Q3.

text.p: Chrysler Corp said on Monday it repurchased $452 million of its common stock in the third quarter, bringing share repurchases for the year to $1.57 billion.
The automaker, announcing third quarter results, said it bought back 15.8 million shares during the quarter.
In the first nine months of the year, it repurchased 51.9 million shares.
The company's board has authorized the repurchase of $2 billion of common stock in 1996 and another $1 billion in 1997.
For the third quarter, Chrysler reported net income of $680 million, or $0.93 per fully diluted share, including a charge of $55 million, or $0.07 a share, for early retirements.
In the third quarter of 1995 Chrysler's net earnings were hurt by the slow launch of its new minivans and came to $354 million, or $0.45 per fully diluted share.
"Chrysler's performance in the third quarter was outstanding," Chairman Robert Eaton said in a statement.

"It was fueled by record-setting demand for our products, which led to a new third quarter U.S. retail unit sales record and produced the best model year for U.S. retail unit sales in the company's history," he said.
Eaton said Chrysler's new labor agreements with the United Auto Workers and Canadian Auto Workers unions represent a "solid foundation" for growing Chrysler's business.
"Our success isn't an aberration, nor have we plateaued; we've merely built a foundation for even better things in the future," he said.

Chrysler's performance set new company records for third quarter net income and earnings per share. Net income as a percentage of total revenues increased to 4.7 percent in the third quarter from 2.9 percent a year earlier.

The automaker's combined U.S. and Canadian retail car and truck market share for the third quarter was 15.5 percent, compared with 13.6 percent in the third quarter of 1995. In the two countries, Chrysler's retail sales were 645,766 vehicles, versus 560,841 in the year-ago period.
